full_judgment: 2. Shorn of unnecessary details, fact of case lies in a very short compus. The petitioners, as plaintiff, filed Other Class Suit No. 33 of 2013 in the Court of Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Chattogram against the plaintiffs in Other Suit No. 130 of 2006, as defendant, for declaration of title in the suit property as well as to declare deed No. 8367 dated 13-12-1986 in the name of defendant No. 1 and deed No. 8699 dated 24-12-1986 in the name of defendant No. 2 to be illegal, collusive, without consideration and not acted upon, along with another declaration to the effect that the BS khatian recorded in the name of defendant No. 3 is wrong and without basis. The defendant Nos. 1 and 2 in the instant suit, as plaintiffs filed Other Suit No. 130 of 2006 for declaration that in their deed Nos. 8699 and E367 corresponding BS Plot Nos. 1558 and 1618 under BS Khatian No. 2125 and BS Khatian No. 2554 wrongly recorded in the name of defendant instead of recording the same in the name of plaintiffs or in the name of their vendor. The plaintiffs in Other Suit No. 33 of 2013 filed an application on 14-11-2018, as defendant Nos. 22-30 in Other Suit No. 130 of 2006 praying for hearing both the suits either analogously or simultaneously, on the ground that the suit property as well as parties are same. The trial court heard the application and after hearing by the impugned judgment and order dated 15-1-2019 rejected the same. Thereafter, the petitioners moved this Court by filing this revision application and obtained the present Rule and order of stay.
